metadata.title: 2249 - Add vendors back for airgapped mode
metadata.author: gcgoncalves

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Put back 3rd party JS scripts and CSS files on the vendors directory to support airgapped mode.

Closes #2249

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
1. Enable the MCPGATEWAY_UI_AIRGAPPED flag on the .env file
2. Start the application
3. Access the UI

## 🐞 Root Cause
The vendor files were not available on the static directory.

## 💡 Fix Description
Restore the files and remove the vendors directory from .gitignore
